name: Multimodal Brain MRI Report Generation
short: Vision-language pipelines for MRI/CT report generation with MedGemma, DenseNet encoders, and LoRA fine-tuning.
full: Vision-language pipelines for MRI/CT report generation with MedGemma, DenseNet encoders, and LoRA fine-tuning — +7% BLEU-4 with RadGraph-E and GREEN gains over a Qwen baseline. Trained on IBM Cloud Pak infrastructure.
